complaints.description: Professional installer reports quality control failures: windows don't function properly, sashes don't fit, constant cutting of welds required
complaints.note: RED — professional (not consumer) reports of systematic QC failures

complaints.description: Consumer reports of frames not being square, difficulty operating sashes, seal failures
complaints.note: YELLOW — consumer complaints corroborate professional assessment

sources.name: Professional installer community
sources.summary: Multiple professionals describe product as 'crap' and 'not a product that a quality oriented contractor would offer.' Strong negative consensus.

sources.name: Reddit/forum community
sources.summary: Consumer and DIY community reports echo professional concerns about quality. Some price-bias present but core complaints are about function, not value.

professional_consensus._note: Strong negative consensus across both professional and consumer pools. Price-bias flagged on Pool C but substantive complaints align with professional assessment.

component_quality._note: Base vinyl with aluminum sash reinforcement and welded construction. Spacer type undisclosed. Standard classification.

repairability._note: Parts availability limited — must contact manufacturer directly, no third-party suppliers. Warranty identification required for parts ordering.

thermal.note: NFRC certified, Energy Star qualified. Basic vinyl replacement window frame. No specific DH U-Factor published.

structural.note: DP-35 standard per Lowe's product page. Consistent across multiple Lowes pages and manufacturer video. Florida approved. No explicit AAMA/FGIA PG listing found.

air_water.note: Manufacturer does not publish air infiltration value for DH configuration. Energy Star / NFRC certified indicates minimum standards met. Scored at certification floor for vinyl material class. Actual performance may be significantly better.
